question: A block of mass m attached to a spring of constant k oscillates on a frictionless horizontal surface. If a small additional mass m is gently placed on top of the block exactly when it is at the mean position (moving with maximum speed), which of the following occurs?
options: The amplitude decreases, and the time period increases
The amplitude remains the same, but the time period increases
The amplitude increases, but the time period remains the same
Neither the amplitude nor the time period changes
explanation:
At the mean position, momentum is conserved during the sudden addition of mass: mv=2mv prime, so v prime=ᵛ⁄₂
The new angular frequency √(ᵏ⁄₂ₘ) is smaller, so the time period increases, and computing the new amplitude from v ᵖʳⁱᵐᵉ⁄ω(new) shows it decreases relative to the original amplitude
